status: Open; benchmark evidence defect confirmed by source inspection, independent measured A/B result remains inconclusive
finding: The ATM-GOV-0243 paired A/B generator labels a pass from timing segments derived from hard-coded policy profiles and synthetic operation counts, not from measured treatment/control makespans. The closure validator checks expected text in the Markdown report instead of recomputing metrics from authenticated raw measurements. The separate real-paired benchmark test explicitly expects the real rollout verdict to remain inconclusive.
expectedBehavior: A benchmark may report a performance improvement only when the reported outcome is computed from attributable, rerunnable measurements of the actual declared control and treatment workflows under the same sealed workload. Synthetic safety fixtures must not satisfy or be represented as external performance proof; closure validation must verify structured measurement inputs and recompute the verdict.
evidenceOrRepro: Static source evidence at HEAD b5bc861c40aef9be0a3d3e1823be2412b327a61d: scripts/run-paired-ab-v4.ts launches paired-ab-v4-cell-workload.ts, which only performs a small deterministic hash loop; runCellWorkload records child-process durationMs, but deriveTiming computes the metrics from operationCount and hard-coded policyProfiles, and buildSummary uses those derived makespans. tests/cli/paired-ab-v4-safety-controller.test.ts and tests/performance/atm-3-paired-queue-compose.test.ts assert a passing result from this generator. scripts/validate-atm-2-1-closure.ts accepts the A/B row by matching fixed strings in docs/reports/atm-2-1-paired-ab-v4.md; it does not recompute against the structured cells. tests/cli/real-paired-ab-v4.test.ts verifies the distinct real analysis is inconclusive and has missing supplemental samples. This establishes the evidence path is not a real A/B measurement; it does not establish that a valid external A/B run has never occurred elsewhere.
followUp: Create a new follow-up task without reopening or rewriting closed ATM-GOV-0243. Keep the real result inconclusive until an independent, sealed-protocol rerun exists. Separate synthetic safety-controller coverage from performance evidence; require actual control/treatment execution receipts, measured makespan and cost inputs, exact source/workload binding, and an independent rerun. Make the closure validator recompute from structured raw measurements and reject modeled timing values or report-only text. Preserve safety assertions and test coverage while reducing the current 630 synthetic child-process launches where practical. Incident-learning candidate: docs/governance/atm-incident-learning-candidates/ATM-BUG-2026-10-03-002.json.
